fee_notes: Royalty is the greater of 8% of Gross Revenues or the Minimum Royalty ($750/month for Core Program plus $50/month for each additional program offered under the Plus Program). National Brand Fund Contribution is the greater of 1% of Gross Revenue or $200/month; franchisor may increase up to 2% upon 60 days' notice. Local Advertising is currently 1% of Gross Revenues (may be required up to 3%). Regional Advertising Cooperative is currently none (may require up to 3% of Gross Revenues in the future). Technology Fee is $200/month for first franchise, $150/month for second YAU Brand business, $100/month for each thereafter; increases by $50/month for each additional Plus Program; may increase by $15/month per additional Google Workspace user. Additional monthly fees include: Recruiting Services/Applicant Tracking System Software $20/month (mandatory first 12 months), Sales CRM $10/month (mandatory first 12 months), Learning Management System $50/year, Bookkeeping up to $150/month (paid to third-party vendor), Credit Card Processing $20/month plus merchant processing fees up to 4%.
raw_excerpt:
Royalty: The greater of 8% of Gross Revenues or the "Minimum." See Note 2. The Minimum is $750 per month for the Core Program plus $50 per month for any additional program that you offer.

National Brand Fund Contribution: The greater of 1% of Gross Revenue or $200 per month. We may increase the National Brand Fund contribution rate up to 2% of Gross Revenues per month upon 60 days' notice.

Local Advertising Expenditures: Up to 3% of Gross Revenues, but currently 1% of Gross Revenues.

Regional Advertising Cooperative Fee: Currently none. We may require you to contribute up to 3% of your Gross Revenues to the cooperative.

Technology Fee - Website, Coach Application, Curriculum Video Content: $200 per month for your first Amazing Athletes Franchised Business; $150 per month for your second YAU Brand business; $100 per month for each YAU Brand business thereafter.

Recruiting Services and Applicant Tracking System Software: Currently $20 per month.

Sales CRM: Currently $10 per month.

Learning Management System: Currently $50 on an annual basis.

Bookkeeping: Up to $150 per month.

Credit Card Processing Fee: $20 per month plus merchant processing fees, which can be as high as 4% of the amount charged.
